items.title: Visual app builder for local codebases
items.oneliner: Open-source visual editor lets designers change real app code locally, bridging Figma and Webflow without leaving the repo.

items.title: Declarative internal app deployments
items.oneliner: OpenRun deploys internal tools to Docker or Kubernetes with built-in auth, RBAC, and Starlark configs instead of custom glue.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 is ready now
items.oneliner: PostgreSQL 19 adds REPACK CONCURRENTLY and plan advice tooling for safer maintenance and stabler query performance at scale.

items.title: PHP 8.6 ships useful runtime upgrades
items.oneliner: PHP 8.6 adds partial function application, a Duration class, and a polling API you can start using today.

items.title: Analog Ising solver with Python SDK
items.oneliner: This GitHub project exposes sub-millisecond analog optimization hardware through a Python SDK and hosted MCP server.

items.title: Ledger UI for PostgreSQL accounting
items.oneliner: pgledger-ui gives double-entry PostgreSQL ledgers a clickable search and trace interface for debugging balances and transfers.

items.title: Local garage door control stack
items.oneliner: A practical walkthrough shows how to replace myQ cloud lock-in with local ratgdo32 control and custom door alerts.

items.title: Raspberry Pi clock runs offline
items.oneliner: This hands-on rebuild moves SVG clock rendering onto a Pi Zero 2 W so it keeps working offline.

items.title: Use compression before buying RAM
items.oneliner: A practical zram guide shows how memory compression can stretch Linux workstation RAM by roughly 3.35x.

items.title: Rust distinct counting from DataSketches
items.oneliner: Deep implementation notes compare HllSketch and CpcSketch while porting Apache DataSketches distinct counting algorithms to Rust.
